title: Carrera GT in the Night Studio Before Dawn
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
description:
Inside the calm of the Night Studio, a satin black Porsche Carrera GT rests under the soft ceiling glow. Outside the window, the first cool blue light of dawn begins to break, letting you know a long night of work is finally behind you. For the next two hours, there is only music to keep you company, drifting through mellow lo-fi hip hop with jazzy keys and a soft head-nod beat that is perfect for working, studying, and relaxing.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
